title: 🙃 Aarav's loop skips the last row... the off-by-one hiding in tests #python #loops
title_alts: 🔢 Aarav's loop counts to nine... why indexes start at zero, not one #python #arrays
😵 Aarav emailed nine of ten... the off-by-one that costs a customer #python #loops
description_hook: Ten names went in. Nine emails went out. The tenth was never touched, and the tests still passed.
setting: a quiet home desk at night with one laptop

characters.name: Aarav
characters.description: twenty-four, short black curly hair, grey hoodie, silver ring on his thumb

claims.claim: runs nine times, not ten
claims.basis: a loop over indexes one to nine touches nine slots, arithmetic from the stated example

claims.claim: the list holds ten names
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: indexes zero through nine
claims.basis: follows from ten items in a zero-based list

claims.claim: the last index is always the length minus one
claims.basis: definition of zero-based indexing

scenes.narration: Aarav's loop runs nine times, not ten.
scenes.caption: आरव का लूप दस बार नहीं, नौ बार चलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen on a dark wooden desk showing a short list of ten names, the tenth name greyed out and untouched while the other nine are marked green, one small lamp lighting the keyboard.

scenes.narration: The list holds ten names. Nine of them get an email.
scenes.caption: लिस्ट में दस नाम हैं। ईमेल सिर्फ़ नौ को जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A mail outbox on a monitor with nine sent message rows stacked neatly and one empty slot at the bottom, warm lamp light falling across the desk.

scenes.narration: The tenth customer never hears from the system at all.
scenes.caption: दसवाँ ग्राहक सिस्टम से कुछ भी नहीं सुनता।
scenes.image_brief: A single unopened envelope lying alone on a desk beside a closed laptop, a mug of cold tea next to it, faint evening light from a window.

scenes.narration: Two minutes from now you will catch this instantly.
scenes.caption: दो मिनट बाद आप इसे तुरंत पकड़ लेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A paper notebook open on a desk showing a hand-drawn row of ten boxes numbered zero to nine, a pencil resting in the fold, bright desk lamp above.

scenes.narration: Indexes start at zero. Counting starts at one.
scenes.caption: इंडेक्स शून्य से शुरू होता है, गिनती एक से।
scenes.image_brief: Ten wooden blocks in a straight line on a table, each painted with a number from zero to nine, soft daylight coming from the side.

scenes.narration: So the last index is always the length minus one.
scenes.caption: इसलिए आख़िरी इंडेक्स हमेशा लंबाई से एक कम होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden ruler on a plain table with ten small stones laid along it, the tenth stone sitting at the nine mark, even flat light.

scenes.narration: Ten items means indexes zero through nine, never ten.
scenes.caption: दस आइटम का मतलब इंडेक्स शून्य से नौ तक, दस नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a row of ten coloured cells with index labels zero to nine printed beneath them, and an empty dotted cell labelled ten sitting outside the row.

scenes.narration: A loop from one to nine quietly skips the first slot.
scenes.caption: एक से नौ तक का लूप पहला स्लॉट चुपचाप छोड़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Nine of ten locker doors on a corridor wall standing open while the very first locker, numbered zero, stays shut, overhead strip lighting.

scenes.narration: Why did the tests pass? They counted rows, not names.
scenes.caption: टेस्ट पास क्यों हुए? उन्होंने गिनती जाँची, नाम नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A test results panel on a monitor with a full column of green ticks and one small grey skipped line at the bottom of the panel.

scenes.narration: Some languages hand you each item directly.
scenes.caption: कुछ भाषाएँ हर आइटम सीधे आपको देती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A short conveyor belt on a workbench carrying ten identical parcels one after another into a waiting crate, no numbers anywhere, cool workshop light.

scenes.narration: Then there is no index, so there is no off-by-one.
scenes.caption: तब इंडेक्स नहीं होता, इसलिए यह गलती भी नहीं होती।
scenes.image_brief: The crate on the workbench now holding all ten parcels, the belt empty and still, a clipboard beside it with every line ticked.

scenes.narration: Off-by-one is not carelessness. It is arithmetic.
scenes.caption: ऑफ़-बाय-वन लापरवाही नहीं, यह गणित है।
scenes.image_brief: A chalk board with one line of chalk arithmetic reading length minus one, a duster resting on the ledge, plain room, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Open your newest loop and print both end items.
scenes.caption: अपना सबसे नया लूप खोलें और दोनों सिरों के आइटम प्रिंट करें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing two lines of printed output, the first list entry and the last list entry one under the other, tidy desk, morning light.

title: 😵 Nandini's function keeps yesterday's list... the default argument trap #python #functions
title_alts: 🧺 Nandini's empty list is not empty... how a default is really built #python #functions
🔁 Nandini's report grows every run... the mutable default that bites #python #debugging
description_hook: Her function starts with an empty list every time. Except it does not, and the third run proves it.
setting: a small office desk with a second monitor
protagonist_type: backend developer on a small team

characters.name: Nandini
characters.description: thirty-one, long dark hair tied back, olive green shirt, thin wire-framed glasses

claims.claim: three new orders each run
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: by the third run the report shows nine
claims.basis: three orders per run accumulated over three runs, arithmetic from the stated figures

claims.claim: the second call returns six
claims.basis: three plus three from the figures already stated

claims.claim: built once, when the function is defined
claims.basis: standard evaluation order of default parameters in Python

scenes.narration: The empty list in your function is not empty.
scenes.caption: आपके फ़ंक्शन की खाली लिस्ट असल में खाली नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a short function definition whose empty square brackets glow faintly amber, dim office at dusk, keyboard lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: Nandini's function gathers three new orders each run.
scenes.caption: नंदिनी का फ़ंक्शन हर रन में तीन नए ऑर्डर जोड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A screen with a small table of three order rows, an order number and a price in each row, a mug and a notepad beside the keyboard.

scenes.narration: By the third run the report shows nine.
scenes.caption: तीसरे रन तक रिपोर्ट में नौ दिखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The same on-screen table now stretched to nine order rows with a scrollbar on the right, the top rows faded as if older.

scenes.narration: You will see why, and the one line that fixes it.
scenes.caption: आप कारण देखेंगे, और वह एक लाइन जो इसे ठीक करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A sticky note pressed to the edge of a monitor with one short line of code written on it in marker, office ceiling light overhead.

scenes.narration: A default value is built once, when the function is defined.
scenes.caption: डिफ़ॉल्ट वैल्यू एक बार बनती है, जब फ़ंक्शन बनाया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single empty glass bowl on a bare wooden shelf with a small paper label reading default taped beneath it, soft side light.

scenes.narration: Every later call reaches into that same list.
scenes.caption: हर अगली कॉल उसी एक लिस्ट में हाथ डालती है।
scenes.image_brief: Three hands reaching toward the same glass bowl on the shelf, each dropping a small folded paper slip into it, the bowl filling up.

scenes.narration: The first call returns three orders. Fair enough.
scenes.caption: पहली कॉल तीन ऑर्डर देती है। ठीक है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed slip on a desk listing three order lines and a total, a small printer beside it, evening light through the blinds.

scenes.narration: The second call returns six. Nothing was added twice.
scenes.caption: दूसरी कॉल छह देती है। कुछ भी दो बार नहीं जोड़ा गया।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed slips lying side by side on a desk, the left one with three order lines and the right one with six, the extra three circled in pen.

scenes.narration: The list simply never went back to empty.
scenes.caption: लिस्ट कभी दोबारा खाली ही नहीं हुई।
scenes.image_brief: The glass bowl on the shelf packed with paper slips spilling onto the shelf, the default label still visible under the pile.

scenes.narration: Numbers, strings and tuples cannot be changed in place.
scenes.caption: नंबर, स्ट्रिंग और टपल जगह पर नहीं बदले जा सकते।
scenes.image_brief: Three sealed glass paperweights on a desk, a different number frozen inside each one, nothing able to get in or out, cool window light.

scenes.narration: Lists, dictionaries and sets are the ones that remember.
scenes.caption: लिस्ट, डिक्शनरी और सेट वही हैं जो याद रखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Three open containers on the same desk, a bowl, a filing box and a jar, each half full of folded paper slips, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Default to none. Build the list inside the function body.
scenes.caption: डिफ़ॉल्ट को none रखें। लिस्ट फ़ंक्शन के अंदर बनाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing the corrected function, the default now the word None, and a fresh empty list created on the first line of the body.

scenes.narration: Search your project for empty brackets inside a signature.
scenes.caption: अपने प्रोजेक्ट में सिग्नेचर के अंदर खाली ब्रैकेट खोजें।
scenes.image_brief: A code editor search panel open with a query typed into it and four matching result lines listed beneath it, quiet office, screen glow.

title: 🪙 Kartik's invoice lands one cent short... the floating point money trap #python #floats
title_alts: 🔬 Kartik's total will not add up... how computers really store a decimal #python #floats
🧮 Kartik stored money as decimals... the rounding drift audits catch #python #numbers
description_hook: Three items of ten cents each, and the invoice says twenty-nine. The arithmetic is fine. The storage is not.
setting: a billing desk with a printer and a wide monitor

characters.name: Kartik
characters.description: twenty-nine, close-cropped hair, navy shirt with sleeves rolled up, a pencil behind one ear

claims.claim: point one plus point two is not point three
claims.basis: standard result of binary floating point representation, reproducible in any language using doubles

claims.claim: three items of ten cents each
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: the invoice prints twenty-nine cents
claims.basis: illustrative outcome of truncating a drifted total, chosen to show the direction of the error

claims.claim: printed to twenty digits
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: one tenth has no exact form in base two
claims.basis: one tenth is not a finite sum of powers of two, a property of the number base

scenes.narration: Point one plus point two is not point three.
scenes.caption: ज़ीरो पॉइंट एक और ज़ीरो पॉइंट दो मिलकर ज़ीरो पॉइंट तीन नहीं बनते।
scenes.image_brief: A wide monitor on a billing desk showing one line of numeric output ending in a long tail of threes, the rest of the screen dark, cool blue glow on the desk.

scenes.narration: Kartik bills three items. Each one costs ten cents.
scenes.caption: कार्तिक तीन चीज़ें बिल करता है। हर एक दस सेंट की है।
scenes.image_brief: A paper invoice on a desk listing three identical line items with a small amount beside each, a stapler and a calculator next to it, warm overhead light.

scenes.narration: The printed total says twenty-nine. It should say thirty.
scenes.caption: प्रिंट किया गया कुल उनतीस कहता है। यह तीस होना चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A printed invoice slip lying on a desk with the total line circled in red pen, the figure one unit lower than the sum of the rows above it.

scenes.narration: You will see where the cent goes, and how to keep it.
scenes.caption: आप देखेंगे कि वह सेंट कहाँ जाता है, और उसे कैसे बचाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A single coin standing on its edge on a wooden desk beside a closed paper invoice, a bright desk lamp throwing a long thin shadow.

scenes.narration: Computers store numbers in base two. We write them in base ten.
scenes.caption: कंप्यूटर नंबर बेस टू में रखता है। हम उन्हें बेस टेन में लिखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two rows of light switches on a wall panel, the top row labelled with tens and the bottom row with ones and zeros, plain even light.

scenes.narration: One tenth has no exact form in base two.
scenes.caption: एक बटा दस का बेस टू में कोई पूरा रूप नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A measuring jug on a kitchen counter with markings that never quite line up with the water level inside it, clear daylight from a side window.

scenes.narration: So it is kept as the nearest neighbour instead.
scenes.caption: इसलिए उसे सबसे नज़दीकी पड़ोसी के रूप में रखा जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A number line drawn on paper with tick marks, and a small bead resting just to the right of a labelled tick instead of on it, desk lamp above.

scenes.narration: Add three neighbours together. Now the gap is big enough to print.
scenes.caption: तीन पड़ोसियों को जोड़ें। अब फ़र्क़ प्रिंट होने लायक़ बड़ा हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Three beads on a paper number line pushed together to one side, their combined offset now clearly past a labelled tick mark, flat light.

scenes.narration: Printed to twenty digits, the total carries a stray tail.
scenes.caption: बीस अंकों तक प्रिंट करें, तो कुल में एक अजीब पूँछ दिखती है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing one long decimal number stretching across the screen, its final digits trailing off away from a clean round figure.

scenes.narration: For averages and graphics, that tail never matters.
scenes.caption: औसत और ग्राफ़िक्स के लिए वह पूँछ कोई मायने नहीं रखती।
scenes.image_brief: A smooth line chart filling a monitor on a desk, the curve clean and unbroken, a small ruler resting against the screen bezel.

scenes.narration: For money, it stacks up across thousands of rows.
scenes.caption: पैसे के मामले में यह हज़ारों रो में जमा होता रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A long continuous printout of an account ledger spilling off the edge of a desk onto the floor, small differences marked in red along the right column.

scenes.narration: Store money as whole cents. Integers never drift.
scenes.caption: पैसे को पूरे सेंट में रखें। पूर्णांक कभी नहीं खिसकते।
scenes.image_brief: A tray of identical coins sorted into neat counted rows on a desk, each row the same length, bright even light from above.

scenes.narration: Print one total from your code with twenty digits tonight.
scenes.caption: आज अपने कोड का एक कुल बीस अंकों तक प्रिंट करके देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a tidy desk showing a single long decimal figure on an otherwise empty terminal screen, late evening light in the room.

title: 🌀 Sneha's function calls itself forever... the missing base case #python #recursion
title_alts: 🪜 Sneha's countdown never reaches zero... how the call stack fills up #python #recursion
💥 Sneha hit a stack overflow... the stop condition to write first #python #debugging
description_hook: A countdown that calls itself is elegant until it never stops. Here is what fills up, and how fast.
setting: a shared flat at midnight, one lamp and a laptop

characters.name: Sneha
characters.description: twenty-two, shoulder-length hair with a blue streak, oversized black t-shirt, wristband of woven thread

claims.claim: a few thousand frames deep
claims.basis: round illustrative figure for a default stack limit, stated as approximate in the narration

claims.claim: starts at ten
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: past zero into minus one, minus two
claims.basis: follows from subtracting one each call with no stop condition

scenes.narration: Sneha's countdown never reaches zero. The program dies instead.
scenes.caption: स्नेहा की गिनती कभी ज़ीरो तक नहीं पहुँचती। प्रोग्राम पहले ही मर जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen in a dark room filled with an identical error line repeated down the whole display, one lamp glowing behind it at midnight.

scenes.narration: Recursion means a function that calls a smaller copy of itself. Elegant. Also risky.
scenes.caption: रिकर्शन का मतलब है फ़ंक्शन जो अपनी छोटी नक़ल को बुलाता है। सुंदर, मगर जोखिम भरा।
scenes.image_brief: A set of nested wooden dolls opened and lined up from largest to smallest on a desk beside a laptop, warm lamp light from the left.

scenes.narration: Each call waits for the call inside it to finish. Nothing returns yet.
scenes.caption: हर कॉल अपने अंदर की कॉल के ख़त्म होने का इंतज़ार करती है। कुछ भी लौटता नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A stack of unwashed plates rising on a kitchen counter, each plate waiting on the one above it, the lowest plate pressed flat, dim night light.

scenes.narration: Two minutes, and you will know the line that stops this.
scenes.caption: दो मिनट, और आपको वह लाइन पता चल जाएगी जो इसे रोकती है।
scenes.image_brief: A sticky note on a laptop lid with a single short line of code written in marker, a mug of tea beside it, quiet room at night.

scenes.narration: Every unfinished call parks a frame on the call stack. The frames pile up.
scenes.caption: हर अधूरी कॉल स्टैक पर एक फ़्रेम रख देती है। फ़्रेम जमा होते जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A tall narrow shelf being loaded with identical paper trays from the bottom upward, the top trays reaching the ceiling, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: That stack has a hard ceiling, often a few thousand frames deep.
scenes.caption: उस स्टैक की एक पक्की सीमा है, अक्सर कुछ हज़ार फ़्रेम गहरी।
scenes.image_brief: The same shelf of paper trays now pressed against a concrete ceiling, the topmost tray bent and crumpled against it, harsh light.

scenes.narration: Her countdown starts at ten and subtracts one each time. Fine so far.
scenes.caption: उसकी गिनती दस से शुरू होती है और हर बार एक घटाती है। अभी तक ठीक है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor listing a descending column of numbers from ten down to one, each on its own line, the last line still blinking.

scenes.narration: Nothing tells it to stop, so it runs into minus one, minus two, forever.
scenes.caption: कुछ भी उसे रुकने को नहीं कहता, तो वह माइनस एक, माइनस दो, यूँ ही चलती रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: The same monitor now scrolling far below zero with a long column of negative numbers blurring past, the scrollbar shrunk to a sliver.

scenes.narration: Is recursion the problem? No. The missing stop condition is.
scenes.caption: क्या रिकर्शन ग़लत है? नहीं। कमी उस रोकने वाली शर्त की है।
scenes.image_brief: A folder tree diagram drawn on a whiteboard, branches ending in clearly marked leaf boxes, a marker resting on the ledge below.

scenes.narration: Write the stopping condition first. Then write the call that shrinks the problem.
scenes.caption: पहले रोकने वाली शर्त लिखें। उसके बाद वह कॉल लिखें जो काम छोटा करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A notebook page with two numbered lines written on it, the first line boxed and underlined twice, a pen lying across the page, lamp light.

scenes.narration: Open a recursive function tonight and read its very first line.
scenes.caption: आज एक रिकर्सिव फ़ंक्शन खोलें और उसकी सबसे पहली लाइन पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a bed with a short function visible on screen, the first line inside the function highlighted, blanket and lamp around it.

title: 🙈 Yash added a gitignore too late... the file git keeps tracking #git #gitignore
title_alts: 🔐 Yash committed a password once... why gitignore cannot take it back #git #secrets
🧹 Yash's ignored file keeps shipping... the cached flag he never ran #git #versioncontrol
description_hook: He added the file to gitignore, committed, and it shipped anyway. Gitignore was never the tool for this job.
setting: a co-working desk with a laptop and a paper notebook

characters.name: Yash
characters.description: twenty-six, wavy hair pushed back, maroon t-shirt under an open denim jacket, a plaster on one finger

claims.claim: one committed file
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: gitignore applies to untracked files only
claims.basis: documented behaviour of git ignore rules, unchanged across versions

claims.claim: the old commit still holds the password
claims.basis: commits are immutable snapshots, so removing a file later does not alter earlier history

scenes.narration: Gitignore stops new files. Tracked files keep right on going.
scenes.caption: gitignore नई फ़ाइलें रोकता है। ट्रैक हो रही फ़ाइलें चलती रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a co-working desk showing a file list where one filename sits in a tracked column despite a rule written beside it, cool morning light.

scenes.narration: Yash's config file holds a password. It was committed weeks ago.
scenes.caption: यश की कॉन्फ़िग फ़ाइल में पासवर्ड है। वह हफ़्तों पहले कमिट हो चुकी है।
scenes.image_brief: A paper notebook open on a desk with a short line of settings written out and one line blacked out with marker, a laptop closed beside it.

scenes.narration: He adds the name to gitignore, commits, and it ships again.
scenes.caption: वह नाम gitignore में डालता है, कमिट करता है, और वह फिर भी चली जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A sealed envelope moving along a mail chute with a small folded slip clearly visible through its window, plain corridor light.

scenes.narration: You will learn two commands, and the order that matters.
scenes.caption: आप दो कमांड सीखेंगे, और वह क्रम जो मायने रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two index cards laid one above the other on a desk, each with a short command written in pen, the upper card numbered one.

scenes.narration: Gitignore decides what git picks up. Not what it already holds.
scenes.caption: gitignore तय करता है गिट क्या नया उठाएगा। यह नहीं कि पहले से क्या पकड़ा है।
scenes.image_brief: A doorman rope across a warehouse entrance with new crates held outside, while identical crates already sit inside on the floor, flat light.

scenes.narration: A tracked file lives in the index, so every edit rides along.

title: 🛠️ Fix Your Recursion Bug Before It Explodes…
title_alts: How to Spot Infinite Recursion
Prevent Recursion Stack Overflows
description_hook: Ever seen your program run forever? Learn how a tiny oversight can trap your code and how to stop it in seconds.

claims.claim: A single missing base case can make your code run forever.
claims.basis: programming logic

claims.claim: Every recursive call adds a frame to the stack, consuming memory.
claims.basis: stack memory usage

claims.claim: Tail recursion can hide the problem if not optimized.
claims.basis: compiler optimization behavior

scenes.narration: A single missing base case can make your code run forever.
scenes.caption: एक बेस केस छूट जाने पर कोड अनिश्चित रूप से चलेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A computer screen showing an infinite loop animation, bright red error sign.

scenes.narration: Recursion simplifies complex problems by breaking them down.
scenes.caption: रिपीटेड कॉल्स जटिल समस्याओं को सरल करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Diagram of recursive function calls branching out like a tree.

scenes.narration: But missing a termination condition turns it into a trap.
scenes.caption: अंत शर्त न होने से यह जाल बन जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Same diagram but with a red stop sign missing at the leaf.

scenes.narration: By the end, you’ll spot and fix any infinite recursion instantly.
scenes.caption: अंत में आप तुरंत अनंत पुनरावृत्ति पहचानकर ठीक कर लेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A checkmark overlay on a code editor screen.

scenes.narration: Every recursive call adds a frame to the stack, consuming memory.
scenes.caption: हर कॉल स्टैक पर फ्रेम जोड़ता है, मेमोरी खपत बढ़ती है।
scenes.image_brief: Illustration of a stack growing taller with each call.

scenes.narration: When the base case never triggers, the stack overflows and crashes.
scenes.caption: बेस केस न आने पर स्टैक ओवरफ्लो और क्रैश।
scenes.image_brief: Stack overflow error message on screen.

scenes.narration: Consider factorial: n! = n * (n-1)! with base 1! = 1.
scenes.caption: फैक्टोरियल: n! = n × (n-1)! बेस 1! = 1।
scenes.image_brief: Code snippet of factorial function with correct base case.

scenes.narration: If you remove 1! = 1, the function never ends.
scenes.caption: यदि 1! = 1 हटाएँ, फ़ंक्शन कभी समाप्त नहीं होगा।
scenes.image_brief: Same code snippet with base case commented out, infinite loop animation.

scenes.narration: This issue appears only with recursion, not loops.
scenes.caption: यह समस्या केवल रिकर्सन में होती है, लूप में नहीं।
